verdict.rationale: Loops documents a public REST API with Bearer-token auth and concrete endpoints such as POST /events/send and POST /contacts/create. Coverage extends to campaigns via the Content API and to workflow graphs, and a probe confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json. The founder also describes a performant, versioned API, and typed SDKs are offered. Missing for 10: independent, non-vendor hands-on reports of driving the product through the API.
